items.summary: Autumn is prime time for big muskies. It’s when the prized fish are feeding heavily to put on weight for the forthcoming winter when forage pickings are slim. Mike Durkalec is a hard-charging muskie man who knows that fall is the time to catch the big, toothy fish.

items.title: Why the 4/0 EWG Just Might Be the Best Bass Hook of All Time
items.summary: You can find countless hook brands and styles on the market now. But, in my opinion, none are as versatile as the Gamakatsu EWG (Extra Wide Gap). This hook has dozens of applications in the bass fishing space, from rigging soft plastics to its incorporation into swing heads and even some skirted baits.
